name: Grandparents
overview: Scripture highlights the vital role of grandparents in passing down God’s truth and wisdom to future generations, as seen in Deuteronomy 4:9 which commands teaching 'thy sons, and thy sons' sons.' The Psalms affirm the enduring fruitfulness and strength of the elderly, encouraging reliance on God’s sustaining grace in old age (Psalms 71:9, 92:14). The faithful are assured that God does not forsake them or their descendants (Psalms 37:25), and that a life counted wisely leads to godly understanding (Psalms 90:12), reflecting the gracious character of God who is merciful and longsuffering (Exodus 34:6).
